description: The OCSC report, used for every Word document unless the person names another template: digital cover, Notice and Document Control, Table of Contents, numbered sections and the office's back cover.

fields.project_number: OCSC job number, for example HEL18. On the cover, the document control table and the footers.
fields.project_name: Project name, on the cover and in the footers.
fields.client_name: The client the document is for, on the cover and in the Notice.
fields.author: Who wrote it, usually the person you are working for.
fields.revision: First revision code; P01 unless the person gives one (C01 once issued). Each edited version adds the next revision by itself.
fields.date: Issue date; today unless the person gives one.
fields.status: Status / suitability code, for example S2. Left blank when not given.
fields.zone: Zone / volume code. Left blank when not given.
fields.level: Level code. Left blank when not given.
fields.role_type: Role code. Left blank when not given.
fields.number: Document number. Left blank when not given.
fields.checked_by: Who checked it. Left blank when not given.
fields.approved_by: Who authorised it. Left blank when not given.
